title: 1RB0LB_1RC0LA_1LB0RD_1RE1RD_1RB1RF_1LA--- and its twin: the far-end rules in Lean, so every stop rule of the table is proved
text: The sweeps that end at the other kind of sample, E0 (after the pairs b2_3 b1_2 and b2_3 b1_1), are proved for every chain of T digits through a second generic theorem, sweepGenE0, and from any E0 sample the next one is an E sample 8 steps later, the end run having become an O digit (e0toE). With the stop rules of 25 November, every stop part of the exact rule table is now proved in Lean for every carry length (53 pieces, 26 sweep theorems per folder). The invariant a non-halting proof needs is still open.
